# #4170: Patch: after the opponent's reply, the AI counts no attack this turn from its own unit that is still Frozen or just arrived, as the engine allows none
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When the computer opponent plans a turn, it imagines your reply and then judges where it will stand at the start of its next turn. At that point it counts its own frozen units as if they could attack, though the game will not let them. It does the same for a unit that only arrived at the start of that turn. The clearest case is Gargantuar, a 12/12 that freezes itself after it attacks. The AI sees no cost in attacking with it, because it still expects those 12 damage at your face next turn.

Once this is built, the AI plans with the attacks it will really have. Gargantuar's freeze, an army you froze, or a Cryofluid on a unit that already attacked all count as the setbacks they are. Players facing the practice AI and the ladder bots see a little less wishful play. Nothing changes for a human's own moves.

## Why

- **Where the AI reads it.** The AI scores its finalists after the opponent's reply with `NextSwing::Seat` (`crates/ai/src/reply.rs:832-836`). That makes `on_turn_swings` true (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:2925-2928`), so `face_threat_from` counts the attacks the seat makes this turn (`evaluate.rs:1303-1345`).
- **Why the freeze check misses it.** The only freeze check there is `can_swing` (`evaluate.rs:136-140`), which asks the engine's `frozen_next_turn` (`crates/engine/src/freeze.rs:130-135`). That answers 'not frozen' for a unit that thaws at the cleanup of the turn under way. The answer is right at the end of a turn (R1174000) and wrong at its start. The engine refuses any Frozen attacker (`crates/engine/src/combat.rs:434`) and thaws it only at that turn's cleanup (`freeze.rs:114-125`).
- **The cards that hit it.** A freeze that lands on the opponent's turn, or after the unit spent its attack, is stamped with its controller's next turn (`thaw_turn`, `freeze.rs:32-39`). The reply produces exactly that case:
  - S+ #27 Gargantuar (After this attacks, Freeze it)
  - S+ #22 Cryofluid played on an own unit after it attacked
  - the opponent's S+ #91 Tsunami attacking, and S #175 Frost Module's Activate, inside the reply (`visible_activation`)
  - S #146 Flash Freeze cast on the seat's own draw
- **Summoning sickness has the same hole.** The comment at `evaluate.rs:1330-1331` (Nor is it summoning sick then) holds only for the end-of-turn read. At the seat's turn start, a unit that entered the field this turn (`is_sick`, `combat.rs:264`) cannot hit the hero without Charge, yet it is counted at the hero. Examples: the Rush Token of Core #58 Rush Token Farm, the Conscript of S+ #26 Jlockeed's Forever War, and Core #65 Masochism Mask's Spikey Pillow.
- **The same fix already exists for Brittle, Burn and Toxic.** R3793000 and R4065000 gave `crumbles_before_swing` and `afflicted_before_swing` this frame for the same reason (`evaluate.rs:147-214`). The freeze and sickness reads never got it.
- **Why it matters.** The pressure term counts these swings: `pressure_per_damage`, or `lethal_on_board` once they reach the enemy's life (`evaluate.rs:2940-2948`). So a reply-scored line can credit itself a lethal on board that it does not have.
- **A stale header.** `crates/ai/tests/ai/freeze.rs` still says no card freezes, though a dozen shipped cards do.

## Proposal

1. Add an `EvalWeights` flag, on in `AI_EVAL` and off in `GREEDY_EVAL`, as R3793000's and R4065000's flags are. The greedy baseline the gates measure against then plays as it does today.
2. With the flag on, `face_threat_from` changes only when `on_turn_swings` holds and the unit's controller is on turn, so its attacks are this turn's:
   - a unit with any freeze stamp (`frozen.is_some()`) is left out, as the engine refuses its attack;
   - a unit summoning sick this turn (`is_sick`) without Charge lands nothing on the hero.
   Every other read stays as it is. `frozen_next_turn` and the end-of-turn frame are right, and `unit_worth` keeps pricing the unit as one that will swing again.
3. Add a ruling note in the issue's block for the read, by Hearthstone semantics: a frozen minion misses the attack it would have made, and a minion summoned this turn attacks a hero only with Charge. Give it proving tests, put its paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`, and write a line in SPEC §9.9's Evaluation bullet and the README beside R3793000's.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` (`can_swing`, `face_threat_from`)
- `crates/ai/src/config.rs` (the flag in `EvalWeights`, `AI_EVAL`, `GREEDY_EVAL`)
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/freeze.rs` (the new tests and the header), plus a sickness test beside them
- `crates/ai/README.md` (the evaluation paragraph), SPEC §9.9 (Evaluation), a new `spec/rulings/R<n>.md` and `spec/pending/<issue>.md`
- Read only: `crates/engine/src/freeze.rs`, `crates/engine/src/combat.rs`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The AI is on turn, scored under `NextSwing::Seat`, and its unit is Frozen to thaw at this turn's cleanup: that unit adds nothing to the AI's face damage in `evaluate`. `face_threat`, the end-of-turn read, still counts it, as `r1174000_face_threat_leaves_out_a_unit_still_frozen_next_turn` holds today.
- [ ] An engine-driven test: Gargantuar attacks and freezes itself, the opponent's reply plays out through `simulate_reply`, and the AI's score at its next turn counts none of Gargantuar's attack. This test fails on `main`.
- [ ] Under the same frame, a unit that entered the field this turn adds nothing at the hero without Charge, and still counts with Charge.
- [ ] Under `GREEDY_EVAL`, every one of these reads as it does on `main`.
- [ ] The header of `tests/ai/freeze.rs` names the cards that freeze now.
- [ ] These all pass: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check` and `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke).
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes.

## Size and risks

Small: one flag, about twenty lines in `face_threat_from`, three or four tests, the ruling and the docs.

It changes the AI's decisions in games where a freeze or a turn-start summon meets a line scored after the reply. Any pinned AI fixture whose game holds one may need its expected result updated, and the PR should say so.

This fixes a misread; it is not a measured strength gain. The gates catch only a broken AI, as SPEC §9.9 says. It reads only units on the field, which the seat sees, so no hidden information is involved.

# Plan — issue #4170: AI counts no attack this turn from its own Frozen or just-summoned unit

## Goal

After the opponent's reply, the AI scores its finalists at its own turn start (`NextSwing::Seat`). In that frame only, `face_threat_from` leaves out the seat's own units the engine will not let swing this turn: any unit with a freeze stamp (`frozen.is_some()`), and any unit summoned this turn (`is_sick`) without Charge at the hero. Everything else — the end-of-turn frame, `frozen_next_turn`, `can_swing`, `unit_worth`, the greedy baseline — reads exactly as today. A new ruling (R4170000, Hearthstone semantics) with proving tests, its `spec/pending/4170.md` paragraph, and doc lines in SPEC §9.9 and `crates/ai/README.md` ship with it.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | New `EvalWeights` flag `frozen_sick_before_swing: bool` with doc comment; `true` in `AI_EVAL`, `false` in `GREEDY_EVAL` (and name it in the "off" list comment at lines 890–893) |
| `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` | change | Import `is_asleep`, `is_sick`; new skip/re-rank block in `face_threat_from`; update `face_threat_with` doc (the line 1330–1331 claim about sickness becomes flag-conditional) |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/freeze.rs` | change | Rewrite stale header; add `OFF` weights const; add 4 tests named below |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | One sentence in the evaluation paragraph after the R4065000 sentence |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | One sentence in the §9.9 Evaluation bullet after the R4065000 sentence, with `[[R4170000]]` |
| `spec/rulings/R4170000.md` | new | The ruling note (lowest free number in the issue's block; verified no `R417*.md` exists) |
| `spec/pending/4170.md` | new | The §11 paragraph for the ruling |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md` (the daily fold owns them); `crates/engine/` and `crates/cards/` (read-only); `can_swing`, `unit_worth`, `could_attack_next_turn` in `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs` (the next-turn frame stays as-is). Governing spec: §9.9 (Evaluation), §4.2 step 1, §6.1, §6.3 Freeze, and rulings R1174000, R3793000, R4065000.

## Steps

1. **Re-read the three code sites.** Read `face_threat_from` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:1300-1343`), the `EvalWeights` flag docs plus `AI_EVAL`/`GREEDY_EVAL` (`crates/ai/src/config.rs:367-406`, `595-613`, `894-912`), and the engine truth: `thaw_turn`/`frozen_next_turn` (`crates/engine/src/freeze.rs:32-39,130-135`), `is_sick`/`is_asleep` and the hero-hit refusal (`crates/engine/src/combat.rs:264-273,434,537-541`).
2. **Add the flag in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`.** After `affliction_kills_before_swing`, add `pub frozen_sick_before_swing: bool` with a doc comment in the same style (what it gates, that `unit_worth` is untouched, off reads as before). Set `true` in `AI_EVAL`, `false` in `GREEDY_EVAL`, and append it to the "off" flag list in `GREEDY_EVAL`'s doc comment. (Name chosen to mirror the two older flags; rejected `seat_swings_now_read` as vaguer.)
3. **Gate the read in `face_threat_from` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`).** Add `is_asleep, is_sick` to the existing `jackioh_engine::{...}` import, keeping alphabetical order (`is_asleep` before `is_dormant_starship`, `is_sick` between `is_extra_turn_card` and `is_slumbering`). Inside the unit loop, after the `afflicted_before_swing` block and before the `across_only` read, insert:
   ```rust
   // R4170000, #4170: at the seat's turn start its attacks are this turn's, so the
   // engine's refusals apply: a Frozen unit attacks nothing, and one summoned this
   // turn reaches the hero only with Charge (with Rush only, units alone).
   let swings_now = w.frozen_sick_before_swing && on_turn_swings
       && state.active == unit.controller;
   if swings_now && unit.frozen.is_some() {
       continue;
   }
   let sick_no_hero = swings_now
       && is_sick(state, unit)
       && !has_keyword(&view.keywords, KeywordKind::Charge);
   if sick_no_hero && is_asleep(state, unit, &view.keywords) {
       continue;
   }
   ```
   and change the `may_hit_hero` line to `!(gauntlet || across_only || sick_no_hero) || attack_restriction(...)`. Copy the comment style of the R3793000/R4065000 blocks above it.
4. **Fix the stale doc on `face_threat_with`.** Lines 1330–1331 say a unit is never summoning sick at the read; qualify it the way the brittle/affliction sentences do ("read as at the end of the turn under way …; at the seat's turn start (`frozen_sick_before_swing`, R4170000) …").
5. **Write `spec/rulings/R4170000.md`.** Copy the front-matter shape of `spec/rulings/R3793000.md` (`id: R4170000`, title naming the read and issue #4170, `cards: "§9.9, §4.2, §6.1, §6.3, Core #58, Core #65, S #146, S #175, S+ #22, S+ #26, S+ #27, S+ #91, R49, R83, R171, R636, R1174000, R3793000, R4065000"`, `proven_in: [crates/ai/tests/ai/freeze.rs]`). Body: Hearthstone semantics (a frozen minion misses the attack it would have made; a minion summoned this turn hits heroes only with Charge); the engine facts (`why_cannot_declare` refuses any `frozen.is_some()` attacker and thaws only at that turn's cleanup; `is_sick`/`is_asleep`/Charge rule); what changes (Seat frame only, controller on turn, flag on in `AI_EVAL` / off in `GREEDY_EVAL`); what does not (`frozen_next_turn`, `can_swing`, `unit_worth`, `could_attack_next_turn`).
6. **Write `spec/pending/4170.md`.** One paragraph in the shape of `spec/pending/4155.md`: `**[[R4170000]] … (issue #4170, 2026-11-18)**: …`.
7. **Edit the two docs.** In `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.9 Evaluation, after the sentence ending `([[R4065000]])` (the one before "A Dormant card on the board"), add: "At the seat's own turn start, neither a Frozen unit, which the engine bars from attacking until its cleanup thaws it, nor a unit summoned this turn without Charge threatens the enemy hero ([[R4170000]])." In `crates/ai/README.md`, after the sentence ending `(affliction_kills_before_swing, R4065000, #4065; off in GREEDY_EVAL).`, add the parallel sentence naming `frozen_sick_before_swing`, R4170000, #4170.
8. **Update `crates/ai/tests/ai/freeze.rs`.** Replace the header's "No card freezes yet (M+ #24 Bob is the first, #1185)…" with: among the cards that freeze now are S+ #27 Gargantuar (after it attacks), S+ #22 Cryofluid, S+ #91 Tsunami's hits, S #175 Frost Module's Activate, and S #146 Flash Freeze. Add `const OFF: EvalWeights = EvalWeights { frozen_sick_before_swing: false, ..AI_EVAL };` after the `LIBRARY` const (copies `brittle.rs`). Reuse `board()`, `freeze()`, `AI`, `HUMAN`, `close`, `act`, and `face_threat`/`face_threat_with`/`evaluate`/`NextSwing` (all in scope via `jackioh_ai::*` and `testkit::*`; `find_instance_mut` comes from `testkit::*` as in `brittle.rs`).
9. **Run the checks in Tests, then `cargo jackioh spec check`.** If an AI-fixture test's game holds a freeze plus a reply-scored line and its expectation moves, report it; do not update pinned fixtures silently.

## Tests

All in `crates/ai/tests/ai/freeze.rs`. Scenario boards default to turn 9, AI (p1) on turn, so `NextSwing::Seat` with `active == AI` gives `on_turn_swings == true`.

- `r4170000_a_unit_frozen_through_this_turns_cleanup_adds_no_pressure_at_the_seats_turn_start`: freeze the AI's 4/4 with thaw `== state.turn`. Assert `face_threat(&frozen, AI)` still equals the ready board's (end-of-turn frame untouched, guards `r1174000_…`); assert `close(evaluate(&frozen, AI, NextSwing::Seat, &AI_EVAL) - evaluate(&ready, AI, NextSwing::Seat, &AI_EVAL), -AI_EVAL.pressure_per_damage * 4.0)`; assert the same pair reads equal under `OFF` and under `GREEDY_EVAL`.
- `r4170000_gargantuar_freeze_costs_its_next_turn_attacks_after_the_reply` (engine-driven, fails on main): scenario with `stinkyscapeplus-027` in lane 3 for the AI, empty human board, `LIBRARY` both sides, a `core-011` in each hand. `act` an `Attack` by Gargantuar at `format!("hero-{}", HUMAN.as_str())`; assert its `frozen.is_some()`. `act` `EndTurn`; run `simulate_reply(&ended, AI, &create_node_counter(100, None), &hidden_card_ids(&ended, AI), Prices::NONE)` and assert `after.active == AI`. Assert `face_threat(&after, AI) == 12` (end-of-turn read still counts it); clone, clear the freeze with `find_instance_mut`, and assert `close(evaluate(&cleared, AI, NextSwing::Seat, &AI_EVAL) - evaluate(&after, AI, NextSwing::Seat, &AI_EVAL), AI_EVAL.pressure_per_damage * 12.0)` plus greedy-equality of the pair. (`unit_worth` is freeze-neutral here since `frozen_next_turn` is already false, so only the pressure term moves; enemy at 30 keeps it off `lethal_on_board`.)
- `r4170000_a_unit_summoned_this_turn_adds_nothing_at_the_hero_without_charge`: on `board()`, set the AI unit's `summoned_turn = Some(state.turn)` via `find_instance_mut`. Assert `close(evaluate(&sick, AI, NextSwing::Seat, &OFF) - evaluate(&sick, AI, NextSwing::Seat, &AI_EVAL), AI_EVAL.pressure_per_damage * 4.0)`; then grant Charge (`granted_keywords.push(Keyword::Charge)`) and assert the AI_EVAL score returns to the arrived-unit score; assert greedy-equality of sick vs arrived.
- `r4170000_greedy_eval_reads_frozen_and_new_units_as_before`: frozen-at-cleanup and sick units score identically cleared vs stamped under `GREEDY_EVAL` (differential pins the frozen behavior itself, as `brittle.rs`'s greedy test does).

Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai freeze`, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke), `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`.

## Done when

- [ ] Seat-frame (`NextSwing::Seat`, AI on turn) counts nothing for the AI's unit frozen to thaw at this cleanup; `face_threat` still counts it.
- [ ] Gargantuar engine test fails on `main`, passes with the fix.
- [ ] Sick-this-turn unit counts nothing at the hero without Charge, full with Charge; greedy reads unchanged everywhere.
- [ ] `freeze.rs` header names the freezing cards.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, clippy, fmt, `spec check`, gate smoke, and `classify --claims` pass.

## Risks

- Pinned AI fixtures: a game holding a freeze or turn-start summon on a reply-scored line may change its expected result; report, don't silently re-pin.
- No hidden-information risk: the read touches only units on the field, which the seat sees.
- No determinism risk: a pure filter, no RNG, no node-budget change.
- The `is_asleep` skip vs `may_hit_hero=false` split follows the engine (`Rush` still hits units); on taunt-free boards both read zero, which is what the tests pin.

## Open questions

None.
